narration:0:1620776101:1.text: More and more students arrive. The party officially begins...

say:2:1620776102:1.text: Welcome, students, to the chaos magic party!
say:2:1620776102:1.source_cn: 欢迎大家来到混沌魔法派对的现场！<key:dialog2>

say:6:1620776104:1.text: Did you organize all of this, Professor?
say:6:1620776104:1.source_cn: 难道说派对的组织者竟然是娑丽丝老师？<key:dial...

say:8:1620776105:1.text: I'm sure many of you have been speculating about who organized this party. Now, I'd like to invite the organizer to say a few words.
say:8:1620776105:1.source_cn: 想必大家对于派对的组织者一定有许多猜测吧，下面，我就邀...

narration:10:1620776106:1.text: Pippa slowly walks to the center of the room.

say:12:1620776107:1.text: Hey everyone! I'm Pippa, the creator of chaos magic. When I used magic myself, it never really listened to me, and somehow I accidentally created chaos magic. Then I shared it with everyone just for kicks.
say:12:1620776107:1.source_cn: 大家好！我是皮帕，是混沌魔法的发明者。因为我自己使用魔...

say:13:1620776108:1.text: I never expected it to get this popular. Thank you all for loving my magic.
say:13:1620776108:1.source_cn: 我没想到它会变得这么流行，收获这么多的喜爱，非常感谢大...

say:15:1620776109:1.text: We should be thanking you, Pippa!
say:15:1620776109:1.source_cn: 别客气，皮帕，是我们要谢谢你！

say:17:1620776110:1.text: Even though I invented chaos magic, I don't really understand how it works, so I had this idea...
say:17:1620776110:1.source_cn: 不过，我虽然是混沌魔法的发明者，其实自己也不清楚它背后...

say:18:1620776111:1.text: What if we gather everyone who's interested in chaos magic, let them experiment, and put our heads together? Wouldn't we figure out its secrets much faster? After all, those who love chaos magic might understand it even better than I do!
say:18:1620776111:1.source_cn: 如果能把对混沌魔法感兴趣的大家聚在一起，尽情地试验，研...

say:19:1620776112:1.text: This is why I organized the party! Have fun and make the most of it, everyone!
say:19:1620776112:1.source_cn: 这就是我组织这场派对的原因，希望大家都能享受今天的派对！

say:21:1620776113:1.text: To unravel the mysteries of chaos magic! My heart's racing just thinking about it!
say:21:1620776113:1.source_cn: 探究混沌魔法背后的秘密！感觉热血沸腾起来了！

say:23:1620776114:1.text: Let's go all out and have a blast!
say:23:1620776114:1.source_cn: 大家一起痛痛快快地玩一场吧！
